title: Material Blend 4-Mix Solo #18 (드래곤비늘+스테인드글라스+보태니컬+흑요암금)
prompt:
Professional fashion photograph, full body shot. ONE woman standing.

THE ABSOLUTE DARKEST BLACK SKIN ON EARTH blue-black void complexion darker than night sky, mid 50s goddess, powerlifter bombshell physique THE MOST EXTREME PHYSICALLY POSSIBLE beyond all anatomy limits — immense powerful thighs and shoulders built with real strength, a thick solid waist, overwhelming muscular bulk layered with soft curves everywhere, two thick goddess braids — her body carries 4 different materials at once, each claiming roughly an equal irregular organic share of her body rather than any straight line, zones arranged diagonally and asymmetrically. dragon scales (large thick armor-plate scales, each one substantial and sharply faceted), BLAZING CRIMSON scale formations, VIVID DEEP EMBER scale-edge detail, every scale catching its own glint and casting its own small shadow dominates zone 1. solid thick stained glass fused to her form, hundreds of small individual panes each no larger than a coin, BLAZING ELECTRIC EMERALD and VIVID GOLD panes alternating in a dense irregular mosaic, dark lead-line seams webbing between every pane dominates zone 2. living peony blooms growing directly from her own skin, every stem rooted in her living skin and every petal standing in three-dimensional relief casting its own small shadow, BLAZING CRIMSON blossoms, VIVID EMERALD leaves and tendrils dominates zone 3. polished obsidian stone fused directly to her own form, solid glossy black stone curving to follow her body's true shape, with molten gold seams running between fitted stone sections dominates zone 4. Wherever any two zones meet, the boundary is soft, diagonal or curving rather than a straight line, the materials interweaving and overlapping gradually across an irregular blended border a few inches wide, elements of each scattered into the neighbouring zone, no fabric no seam no garment anywhere, every material fused to or erupting from her own living skin, covering her completely with no bare skin anywhere from neck to ankle. Pose: three-quarter angle, one hand on the outer hip, the other raised overhead — most extreme powerlifter bombshell silhouette ever displayed.
extreme platform heels/boots blending the relevant materials at her feet, extra long nails each matching whichever zone that hand falls in.

MANDATORY pure pitch black void background only, absolutely NO studio backdrop NO texture NO grey NO gradient. ONE woman only. Extreme macro detail on every material and every blended transition. Pattern density MAXIMUM — zero bare skin anywhere from neck to ankle. 8K portrait 2:3 aspect ratio.
